summary: Science quiz web app deployed on Internet Computer (icp0.io). User wants to fix "canister ID not resolved" accessibility issues (notably on Airtel) by connecting a custom domain and also wants preparation guidance for publishing the app on Google Play Store (via TWA/Bubblewrap).
architectural_notes: Mitigate icp0.io DNS/canister-resolution issues by mapping the app to a custom domain (e.g., for Airtel users).
Play Store distribution planned via Android Trusted Web Activity (TWA) wrapper around the existing web app.
known_issues: Some users (e.g., Airtel network) may fail to resolve/open icp0.io canister URLs ("canister ID not resolved" / DNS resolution issues).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Square app icon illustration: a clean, modern science quiz emblem with simple lab/atom motifs, high contrast, no text (playstore-icon.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide feature graphic illustration: abstract science-themed banner with subtle icons (molecule, flask, lightning) and clean gradients, no text (playstore-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png)
- Screenshot-style promo image: a realistic app UI mock of a quiz question screen on a generic phone frame, science-themed background accents, no store badges (playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png)
- Screenshot-style promo image: a realistic app UI mock of results screen on a generic phone frame, celebratory science-themed accents, no text overlays (playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png)

existing_features.title: Update the Internet Computer custom-domain configuration to use the full domain `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` so the app is accessible via that domain instead of the `icp0.io` canister subdomain (to mitigate “canister ID not resolved” / DNS issues on some ISPs).

Update `frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md` to provide clear, English, step-by-step instructions for connecting and verifying the custom domain `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (including where the domain value is configured in the repo).

Add an English, step-by-step guide in the frontend documentation for publishing the existing web app to the Google Play Store using a Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap), tailored to the deployed URL and including required Play Console assets and checklist.
Add the required Play Store/TWA static images to `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and reference them from the Play Store (TWA) publishing guide.

new_feature_requests.summary: Connect and configure custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in for the deployed app to avoid icp0.io DNS/canister resolution issues
Prepare step-by-step instructions/files to publish the web app to Google Play Store using Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap)

projectName: Connect custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in and add Play Store (TWA) publish guide
